# NullContext audit: complete timing matrix

Measured on 2026-11-14. See [scope and findings](sort-audit-2026-11-14.md).

Times are mean microseconds per sort. Every cell is **small / large**. Allocations are bytes per sort, also small / large. All six patterns are measured at both sizes. A dagger marks an implementation with at least one scenario whose standard deviation exceeds 10% of its mean; use the raw confidence intervals before drawing small-delta conclusions.
